description: This file defines the IOSGatewayChatTransport struct implementing the OpenClawChatTransport protocol for iOS, handling chat session management, message sending, and event streaming via a gateway.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: Implements chat transport functionalities for iOS using a gateway, conforming to OpenClawChatTransport, providing methods for session management, message sending, and event handling.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts a chat run session given sessionKey and runId.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Stub for setting active session key; currently does nothing.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets the chat session specified by sessionKey.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts the chat session specified by sessionKey.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for the specified session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments to a session, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway within the specified timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an async stream of chat-related events from the server.
